value.rationale: The algebra n4 is the first natural strictly upper-triangular matrix Lie algebra of nilpotency class three, where central and noncentral prescribed Lie brackets are distinct. The exact classification quantifies a two-to-one central-fiber enhancement that zero-fiber commuting probabilities alone cannot reveal, gives every possible fiber and every adjoint rank in all characteristics, and serves as a precise base case for finite-field nilpotent bracket-word enumeration. It is a full natural invariant, not an arbitrary sample or a mere rephrasing of a known existence criterion.
